contests.title: Chattooga County schools — senior exemption and income increases

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which increases the income cap on the current homestead exemption for senior citizens 70 years of age or older from Chattooga County School District ad valorem taxes for educational purposes from $20,000.00 to $38,000.00, and for the exemption to increase to $41,150.00 for tax year 2027 and to $55,000.00 for tax year 2028 and all subsequent tax years?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which increases the income cap on the current homestead exemption for senior citizens 70 years of age or older from Chattooga County School District ad valorem taxes for educational purposes from $20,000.00 to $38,000.00, and for the exemption to increase to $41,150.00 for tax year 2027 and to $55,000.00 for tax year 2028 and all subsequent tax years?

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which increases the income cap on the current homestead exemption for senior citizens 70 years of age or older from Chattooga County School District ad valorem taxes for educational purposes from $20,000.00 to $38,000.00, and for the exemption to increase to $41,150.00 for tax year 2027 and to $55,000.00 for tax year 2028 and all subsequent tax years?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Raises the income limit for the existing school-tax homestead exemption for qualifying Chattooga County school-district residents age 70 or older from $20,000 to $38,000. Income is the federal adjusted gross income of the resident and spouse for the preceding taxable year. It increases the amount of assessed homestead value exempt from these school taxes from $40,000 to $41,150 for tax year 2027, then to $55,000 for tax year 2028 and later years. Assessed value above the exemption remains taxable. If voters approve, the changes take effect January 1, 2027.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the higher $38,000 income limit and the scheduled $41,150 and $55,000 school-tax homestead exemptions.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject the proposed increases to the income limit and school-tax homestead exemption.
